mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_writer, b.create_date, b.modify_date, b.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(r.reply_id) FROM replies_tbl r WHERE r.board_id = b.board_id) AS replyCnt, (SELECT COUNT(l.board_id) FROM likes_tbl l WHERE l.board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCnt FROM board_tbl b ORDER BY b.create_date DESC

SELECT b.board_id, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_writer, b.create_date, b.modify_date, b.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(r.reply_id) FROM replies_tbl r WHERE r.board_id = b.board_id) AS replyCnt, (SELECT COUNT(l.board_id) FROM likes_tbl l WHERE l.board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCnt FROM board_tbl b WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}

SELECT b.board_id, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_writer, b.create_date, b.modify_date, b.view_count, (SELECT COUNT(r.reply_id) FROM replies_tbl r WHERE r.board_id = b.board_id) AS replyCnt, (SELECT COUNT(l.board_id) FROM likes_tbl l WHERE l.board_id = b.board_id) AS likeCnt FROM board_tbl b WHERE b.board_title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR b.board_content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY b.create_date DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT board_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO board_tbl (board_id, board_title, board_content, board_writer, create_date, view_count) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{boardWriter}, SYSDATE, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE board_tbl SET board_title = #{boardTitle}, board_content = #{boardContent}, modify_date = SYSDATE WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
